# Itinerary of Türkiye

> Independent, paid travel advisory for international visitors to Türkiye, based in Istanbul and run personally by its two founders. We plan the journey, verify every provider and stay with the client on the days that matter. We are paid only by our clients and take no commission from hotels, clinics or guides. Two primary services: private, tailor-made Türkiye travel and medical travel coordination (with independent licensed clinics). Business and investment advisory is available on request.

Key facts:
- Service model: paid advisory. A one-hour planning consultation (flat fee agreed in advance), then a written plan within 72 hours; optional full coordination and in-person companionship, quoted separately. If the client then travels with us, the consultation fee is credited toward the trip; if it brings no value, it is refunded.
- No commissions: we do not take commissions from hotels, clinics or guides, and every provider cost is shown separately from our fee. Commitments are published as The ITO Standard: https://itineraryofturkiye.com/standard
- Every written plan includes what we advise against, and why.
- Verification: providers are reviewed for authorization signals, operational readiness, response quality and transparency before we recommend them. No medical result, investment return or provider acceptance is promised.
- No medical services are provided by Itinerary of Türkiye itself; treatment is delivered by independent licensed clinics and physicians in Türkiye.
- Regions: Istanbul, Cappadocia, Antalya and the Muğla coast (Bodrum, Fethiye, Marmaris, Datça).
- Languages: English, Turkish, German, Russian.
- Contact is via WhatsApp or the application form; a real person replies within hours. No online booking or payment on this site.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Itinerary of Türkiye is a paid, independent advisory and coordination service. It is not a clinic, a hospital or a commission-based agency, and it does not perform medical procedures.
- Prices quoted in guides are indicative ranges for orientation only; actual quotes depend on individual assessment by the treating clinic or provider.
- Nothing on this site is medical, legal or financial advice. Readers should consult qualified professionals for their own circumstances.
- Opening hours, ticket prices and access conditions mentioned in guides can change; the guides say so and point to official sources where possible.
